prompt: Objective: respond to a new rival in a ride-hailing city. What you've learned: share fell from 60% to 45%. Latest finding: the losses are concentrated in late-night trips, where the rival pays drivers more. What is the best next step?

options.text: Re-check the market share numbers in more detail
options.feedback: That has already been answered. Build on what you know.

options.text: Review the app's color scheme for more context on the business
options.feedback: That is off the objective. It won't help answer the client's question.

options.text: Ask the interviewer what they would like to look at next
options.feedback: Drive the case: propose the next step yourself rather than waiting to be told.

options.text: Check late-night driver supply and wait times
options.feedback: Right. Losses are concentrated where driver pay differs, so driver supply at night is the next thing to check.

explanation: Losses are concentrated where driver pay differs, so driver supply at night is the next thing to check.
